title: aronia arbutifolia var. depressa
intro: Aronia arbutifolia var. depressa, commonly known as the low-growing aronia or black chokeberry, is a shrub-like plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Aronia arbutifolia var. depressa are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include aronia melanocarpa, anthocyanins, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its health-promoting effects.
